summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit press release dated August 24, 2026, announcing an Exploration Agreement with Kineepik Métis Local Inc. to support uranium exploration in Saskatchewan. The agreement establishes a framework for engagement, information sharing, collaboration, and community participation in business, employment, and training. This is a routine community agreement, not a special situation. No financial terms, transaction mechanics, or strategic corporate actions are disclosed. The filing is operational in nature and does not trigger any of the specified special-situation categories.
